main_text.l: legisse,uel
si legerit,perfunctorié legisse, uel denique non
intellexisse uideatur. Sic artis medendi fundamenta ab
eo nimium audacter,nec dicam imperitè coercitur,me-
dicationisq; certissimæ summa affectur confusio . Iftud
quidem aduersus hos grauissimos authores fieri,nec pa-
trouum[?],qui uoculam Fernelio reponeret inueniri sem-
per,ut debui,uehementer dolui . At in nobilissima arte
pro ueritate uanitatem haberi prudentissimis meden-
di legibus stolidam temeritatem substitui: denique pro
arte periculum affumi, ita ægrè tuli, ut ab eo tempore
nō coquicuerim[?] donec his meis exercitationibus,qua-
si signo dato excitarem uel quosdam ex multis, qui non
Hippocratis, aut Galeni, sed ueritatis ipsius patrocini-
um suscipercent. Hæc igitur nobis progymnasmata fuc-
riunt,quæ fiunt insignis alicuius uictoriæ prænuntia,cuius
gloriam alijs libentisimè concedo. Quicquid fanè
ago,eo finè ago, ut alijs ad maiora uiam planiorem faci-
am, coq; animo ab omnibus, qui ista legent acceptum
iri[?] confido. Equidem cum de scriptis meis nō magno-
pere laborare soleam,laterecq; semper concupiuerim,ta-
men hoc scriptū meum cupio, & legi,& ad exteros per-
uenire,ut extet aliquod testimonium amoris erga pr-
æclaros illos medicinæ authores mei. Ac ne quis, forte
eorum[?],qui nimia facilitate, uel potius simplicitate in le-
gendis aliorum scriptis decipi se patiantur, existimet
me uel contradicendi studio, uel ambitiosa cupiditate
ad hæc scribenda, impulsum uenisse, Deum immorta-
lem testor nihil mihi tale in mentem incidisse, nihilq;

page.notes: Long s is printed as a plain s throughout (e.g. "fed" = sed, "fubftitui" = substitui, "ftudio" = studio). The first word of the page continues the sentence from the previous page. "trouum" at the start of the sixth line is uncertain and is marked [?]. "coquicuerim" is uncertain and is marked [?]. The word "fuc-riunt" at the line end is a printed hyphenated word and is read as printed; the reading is uncertain. The letters before "q;" in "coq;" and "laterecq;" are uncertain. "iri" before "confido" is uncertain. The word "eorum" at the start of the line that begins "corum,qui" is read as "eorum" with uncertainty. The catchword "uerius" is read from a faint "ucrius" and may be misprinted. The "q" symbols for -que are written as "q;" as the rules require. No page number or signature is printed.
